_comment: Team-owned reference data. This file is the JSON twin of the core.Ref* tables
in bp-sql-layer. The web pipeline (tools/build-dashboard-data.mjs) reads it
instead of the SQL tables so the mock/demo path needs no database.
KEEP THE TWO IN STEP: a change here should be mirrored in 07_seed_reference.sql.
HUB & SPOKE: the CoE hub owns this file, the grade rate card and the per-VDI
class rates. Each spoke owns its propositions, processes (grade + SMV) and
its VDIs. spokeId on a resource = the spoke whose infra pool it belongs to;
null = hub-owned (test/dev machines), which lands in the shared hub pool.
SPOKE COLOURS: colorLight/colorDark are the spoke's accent on each surface.
The set was validated for CVD separation and contrast on both dashboard
surfaces (dataviz six-checks) — if you change one, re-validate the set.
HUMAN COST / SMV MECHANISM: a process carries the GRADE of colleague whose
manual work it displaces plus the SMV (standard minutes value) per case.
gradeRates is the date-effective rate card: benefit is valued at the rate in
force on each item's outcome date, so a pay award never re-values history.
Spokes with different FTE grades simply reference different grade codes.
HUB TEAM COST: peopleCostHistory (ownerId='HUB') is the SOLE source of truth
for the hub's people run-rate used in cost calculation. estateCostHistory's
teamAnnualCostGBP field is retained for schema parity with bp-sql-layer's
core.RefEstateCostHistory table only — it is NOT read for cost calculation.
estateCostHistory now only supplies workingDaysPerYear/productiveHoursPerDay/
effectiveFrom/note.
SPOKE PEOPLE COST (D5 — CHARGED, not informational): each spoke's own
peopleCostHistory record (ownerId = spokeId as a string) IS wired into the
cost engine as of this change: a spoke's pool/day = that spoke's VDI infra/day
+ its own peopleCostHistory record-in-force/365.25, apportioned WITHIN the
spoke by worktime exactly like infra. This changed every spoke's (and the
estate's) reported cost/net-benefit figures — see verify-economics.mjs's
before/after totals. Hub people-cost handling (ownerId='HUB') is unchanged.
VDI RENEWAL / COVERAGE WINDOW: each resource now carries renewalDate (the
annual renewal anchor date; cycles tile every 365 days from it, both forward
and backward), an optional annualCostGBP override (bypasses the costClass
rate when set), an optional licenseExpiryDate (last day of licensed cover),
and status ('active'|'retired'). Outside a VDI's coverage window it costs
£0 AND has zero available capacity that day — see src/reference/economics.ts
for the exact algorithm (mirrored byte-for-byte in build-dashboard-data.mjs
and verify-economics.mjs).
SCOPED GRADES (SCHEMA_VERSION 3): `grades[]` is the grade CODE dimension —
gradeName (canonical display name) plus spokeIds, the list of spokes allowed
to select this grade for a process ([] = universal, every spoke may use it).
This is a SEPARATE axis from gradeRates[].spokeId (below): grades[].spokeIds
gates WHO may assign the grade to a process; gradeRates[].spokeId gates
whether one dated RATE ROW for that grade is a universal figure or a
spoke-specific override. gradeRates[].gradeName is retained on every row
for back-compat reads and is kept mirrored to the matching grades[] entry.
The CL-SUP example below demonstrates a grade scoped to one spoke
(Consumer Lending) with a plain universal rate and no process yet assigned
to it — it changes no number anywhere in the dashboard.
VDI CLASS-RATE SPOKE OVERRIDES: vdiCostHistory rows may also carry an
optional spokeId (same spokeId-as-string convention) to override a class's
annual cost for one spoke only; absent = universal, applies to every spoke.
Resolution for both gradeRates and vdiCostHistory is spoke-first: the
latest effectiveFrom<=day among spoke-matching rows wins outright over any
universal row, else the latest effectiveFrom<=day universal row is used —
see gradeRateOn/vdiClassRate in src/reference/economics.ts (byte-for-byte
mirrored in build-dashboard-data.mjs and 08_report_views.sql).
SPOKE PEOPLE COST (D5 — charged, see peopleCostHistory[] rows' own notes
below for the per-row detail): a spoke's pool/day now = that spoke's own
VDI infra/day + its own peopleCostHistory record-in-force/365.25,
apportioned within the spoke by worktime exactly like infra. Hub people-
cost handling (ownerId='HUB') is unchanged.
VDI ACTIVITY / STALE FLAGGING (D6): targets.vdiStaleDays (default 14) is
APP-SIDE CONFIG, not a SQL column — same convention as the other
targets/thresholdOverrides fields (resolved client-side; report.vw_ResourceActivity
in 08_report_views.sql supplies the raw FirstSeen/LastSeen/Items a consumer
would need to apply the same rule server-side, but the threshold itself
lives only here). A VDI whose activity has had no cases for MORE than
vdiStaleDays days, and whose status isn't 'retired', surfaces a 'staleVdi'
alert (src/alerts/engine.ts) suggesting it for retirement review.
